text: Project Nexus uses a technology stack consisting of Python 3.12 for programming, FastAPI as the web framework, PostgreSQL 16 for the database, and GitHub Actions for CI/CD. | When: As of July 2025 | Involving: Project Nexus | FastAPI was chosen for its async support and automatic OpenAPI docs; PostgreSQL 16 was chosen for its pgvector support for AI workloads and superior JSON/JSONB support; Python 3.12 was chosen for performance and type hints; GitHub Actions was chosen to reduce maintenance overhead via native integration.
